newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank lowers mini-band on real.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank lowers mini-band on real.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank lowered its mini-band on the real currency by buying dollars at 1.0755 and selling at 1.0805 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on June 19 at between 1.0745 and 1.0795 reais per dollar.
Today's result of the auction represents a 0.09 percent decline from the previous mini-band. So far this month, the Central Bank has shifted the mini-band 0.51 percent lower.
